title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction
layout_note: Two stages side by side, split by a vertical dash-dot rule, each with its own two-line centred title. Stage 1 (left) is a perspective run of slanted planes: input photo -> blurred feature map f -> a receding stack of token-grid planes r_1 ... r_K growing in size -> f-hat -> reconstructed photo, with a stepped arrow baseline labelled 'VAE encoding / Multi-scale quantization & Embedding / Decoding'. Stage 2 (right) is a bottom-to-top token diagram: per-scale token groups r_1, r_2 enter 'word embedding and up-interpolation', become e_1, e_2 rows, go through a wide 'VAR Transformer (causal)' bar and come out as predicted r-hat rows compared with target r rows in a 'Cross-Entropy' box; a block-wise causal mask grid sits at the bottom right.
grouping: No frames around the stages; the dash-dot vertical rule and the two stage titles carry the split. In stage 2 every scale's token group is wrapped in its own dashed rounded box (r_1 with 1 token, r_2 with 4, r_3 with 1...9), so groups of tokens read as one scale each; the transformer and embedding steps are wide pale-grey bars spanning all groups.
shapes_depth: Stage 1 uses pseudo-3-D: semi-transparent slanted planes in perspective, with real-photo planes at both ends and grid-patterned planes for the token maps; stage 2 is flat, tokens are small rounded grey-blue squares numbered 1..9 inside dashed rounded group boxes, processing steps are wide light-grey rounded bars without outlines. The mask is a black/grey cell grid with light-blue square outlines for the 1, 4, 9 blocks.
proposed_highlight: No colour for the paper's own part; the novelty (scale-wise tokens) is carried by structure: token groups of growing size (1, 4, 9) shown both as nested planes in stage 1 and as grouped token rows in stage 2, the start token [S] is the one yellow-outlined element, and the block-wise causal mask with outlined 1/4/9 blocks makes the next-scale rule explicit.
lesson: Draw the same unit of the idea (a scale's token map) in both stages - as a growing plane in the tokenizer and as a dashed group of numbered tokens in the transformer - and add the attention-mask grid with the group blocks outlined, so the reader sees which tokens may attend to which.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; no venue printed on the arXiv first page; remembered venue NeurIPS 2024 (not verified). `refs crop` recorded an embedded-image box covering most of the stage-2 diagram (besides the stage-1 photo planes), so photo_share (0.789) overstates the photo area and the palette leaves most of stage 2 out.

arrangement.units: two unframed stage panels separated by a vertical dash-dot rule, each headed by a centred two-line title (Stage 1: tokenizer training, Stage 2: transformer training); in stage 2 each scale's tokens are enclosed by a dashed rounded box
arrangement.inputs_as: a real photo (parrot) as the first slanted plane in stage 1; in stage 2 the token groups r_1, r_2 enter from the bottom
arrangement.losses_at: stage 2: a 'Cross-Entropy' box at the top right receiving arrows from the target r rows and the predicted r-hat rows; stage 1's loss is not drawn
arrangement.shared: the token maps r_k link the stages only by name (r_1, r_2 ... appear in both); no drawn connector across the rule

taxonomy.task: class-conditional image generation by next-scale prediction

insights.structure: Two stages sit side by side behind a dash-dot rule, the tokenizer as a perspective chain of planes on the left and the autoregressive transformer as a bottom-to-top token stack on the right, with the causal mask tucked into the right panel's bottom corner.
insights.data: Token maps are drawn twice: as grid-patterned planes that grow r_1 to r_K in stage 1, and as dashed boxes of 1, 4, 9 numbered rounded token squares in stage 2, with the input and output photos as the end planes of stage 1.
insights.emphasis: The idea is shown by growth in group size (1 -> 4 -> 9 tokens) and the 1/4/9 blocks outlined in light blue on the mask, closed by the equation L = 1^2 + 2^2 + 3^2 = 14; only the [S] start token gets a colour (yellow).
insights.flow: Stage 1 reads left to right along a stepped arrow baseline with stage labels under it; stage 2 reads bottom to top, embedding bar -> transformer bar -> predicted rows, with each prediction fanning out from the transformer to the next row above and the loss arrows running right to the Cross-Entropy box.
insights.avoid: Stage 1's overlapping semi-transparent planes and tiny tilted labels (f, r_1, r_K) are hard to read, and nothing links the two stages except repeated symbol names.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
